geometry.origin: X at midspan; Z at mid-depth; Y from 0 to width

material.selection: Existing trial elastic constants only, not final material

boundary: Uy=0 at all nodes (plane strain). Remove rigid modes with Ux=0 at X=0,Y=w/2,Z=0 and Uz=0 at X=+-L/2,Y=w/2,Z=0. End faces receive prescribed exact traction, including self-equilibrated cubic normal stress. Top/bottom free. End tractions carry gravity; datum restraints are not bearings and expected net datum reactions are zero. This is NOT a TS-C support model or free-Y bay.
loads: Explicit consistent body force (0,0,-rho*g) with 3x3x3 integration plus exact end tractions sigma*n with 3x3 surface integration. No element body-force argument, roof LL, prestress or double gravity.
exact_reference: Project-derived polynomial plane-strain elasticity solution for constant gravity. Formula and derivation in README. Check displacement gradients, Hooke law, div(sigma)+b=0, top/bottom traction, end resultants and section resultants independently before FE use. This is not an EIT/ACI formula.
cut_method: Reuse the unchanged S2I traction integrator on both one-sided element faces, 4x4 and 6x6. Compare to analytic resultants and to nodal cut with consistent face-node loads subtracted. All moments about section center Xcut,Y=w/2,Z=0.
units: m, kN, kPa; physical shear stress; tension positive

qa_declared_before_solving.scope: Coupon-only accuracy, not code strength or whole-module convergence; retain all failures.

limits: Prescribed analytic end tractions are not an actual bearing detail
Gravity only, no roof live load
No curved shoulder, free Y edge, actual joint, cracking or design release
No removal of failed S2I results or relaxation of their criteria
